description: Three records, the fixture's three lowest base keys 0500024453765740, 0683586198171516 and 0923877193247330, written out inline at the 36 bytes the shipped data measures so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 is what widens them to the 50 app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy declares. It carries the 2 + 2n shape past the two-record boundary to n = 3, which is eight lines, and the six record lines are grouped r1,r1,r2,r2,r3,r3 rather than alternating: the :96 display on the '00' arm of 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT is followed immediately by the :78 display of the same unchanged record area, so each pair is byte-identical and consecutive. A translation that emitted one line per record, or that interleaved the pairs, is wrong here for every record. The third row widens the zero-fill evidence the first two give: XREF-CUST-ID 000000002 carries eight leading zeros and XREF-ACCT-ID 00000000002 carries ten, so a translation binding either PIC 9 span to a number rather than to its zoned DISPLAY image would drop them and shorten the record. Statically derived, never captured (AAP 0.7.6, risk R-A): every value is read from app/cbl/CBACT03C.cbl, app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy, app/jcl/READXREF.jcl and app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt, because this environment cannot run the COBOL.
